title: Lightning Hammer Warrior
description: A fierce female warrior with purple glowing eyes stands in a dynamic pose, raising her right fist which crackles with intense purple lightning. She holds a large ornate purple warhammer in her left hand, wearing tribal orange and purple armor with exposed midriff and dark hair in a topknot.
prompt: A fierce female warrior with glowing purple eyes and dark hair in a topknot, wearing orange tribal crop top and purple pants with ornate patterns, stands in a powerful stance. She raises her right fist crackling with bright purple lightning bolts while holding a large purple warhammer with intricate designs in her left hand. Dynamic pose, dramatic lighting, dark background, fantasy character art.
